items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: That Fats Wall and James B. Johnson and all those guys.

ctx.x: Yeah, what you do, yeah. Oh, Manny, oh, that man had you rolling, laughing, rolling on the floor, boy, I'm telling you. Yeah.
Well that song was popular in New York way, way back then. Yeah. That Fats Wall and James B. Johnson and all those guys.
Oh, they used to sing it?
